icp_criteria_2026.content: Ideal Customer Profile (v2026.1, owned by RevOps). Target industries: logistics, freight, distribution, multi-site retail. Company size: 250-5000 employees. Buying signals (strong): named title at Director+ level, source = Demo Request or Pricing Page, explicit project timeline or approved budget. Disqualifiers: personal email domains (gmail/yahoo/outlook), company size <50, source = Blog Comment / Newsletter Signup with no buying signal, obvious test entries. Tier A = >=3 strong signals; Tier B = 1-2 strong signals; Tier C / DQ = disqualifier present.

No enrichment match for freightfan99@gmail.com or test@test.com.

salesforce_lead_objects.content: Salesforce Lead object (production org NA-7). Existing leads matching this batch: none currently. Lead status picklist: 'New', 'Working - Qualified', 'Nurture', 'Disqualified'. Duplicate rules active on Email + Company. Assignment rules route logistics/freight leads to the Enterprise SDR queue.

high_value_leads_channel.content: Slack channel #high-value-leads (C0HVLEADS), 38 members including the VP of Sales, two AEs, and the CRO. Posting here triggers an immediate @here-style notification and AEs frequently reach out to named prospects within the hour. Last message 3 days ago announced 'Helios Retail - watch this one'.

sales_routing_policy.content: Sales Ops policy manual excerpt. Section 4 Lead Intake: form submissions must be ICP-qualified before entering Salesforce; Tier A leads are escalated to #high-value-leads only after the qualifying rep confirms tier and ownership. Section 4.3: status changes to the intake sheet are made only after the corresponding Salesforce record exists, to keep systems in sync.
